procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
SUI 221735 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1).
However, there was good reason for the PC to extend the time limit.
Frederik Lassenius attend the hearing as a observer.
facts: At race Q5 wind was 15 knots, choppy waves.
5 length from mark 1 SUI 221735 on starboard tack close-hauled course at the layline.
SWE 224454 on port tack on a closed hauled course to the same mark on a contact course to SUI 221735.
There where different boats windward overlapped to SUI 221735.
In the zone 2 boats lengths to the mark SWE 224454 luffed and passed head to wind in front of SUI 221735.
SUI 221735 attempted to luffed, but there was another boat directly windward of her.
SUI 221735 tried to bear away behind SWE 224454 but contact accurred between SUI 221735 bow and the rudder of SWE 224454.
After contact the rudder gudgeon of SWE 224454 was detouched.
There is minor gelcoat damage at SUI 221735.
SWE 224454 retired race 5

conclusions: After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, SWE 224454 failed to keep clear of SUI
SWE 224454 did not avoid contact with SUI 221735 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for SUI 221735 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with SWE 224454 when it became clear that SWE 224454 was not keeping clear. SUI 221735 did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: By retiring from race 5 SWE 224454 took the applicably penalty. No further penalty applies.
